Black Trumpet Farm is proud to be a Pledged Living Wage employer through Just Economics of Western NC. Just Economics calculates the actual cost of living in our region — housing, food, healthcare, transportation, childcare — and sets a wage floor based on what it really takes to live with dignity here. In 2026, that number is $24.10/hour for Buncombe County, based on what a single worker needs to qualify for a one-bedroom apartment. For context, NC's minimum wage is still $7.25. Just Economics certifies two levels of commitment. Fully certified employers pay at least $24.10/hour right now. Pledged employers pay a minimum of $20/hour and have made a binding public commitment to increase wages every year by 3% plus the annual rate of inflation until we reach full certification. When you buy from us at farmer's markets or through one of our restaurant partners, you're supporting a farm that takes this seriously. Our main goal is to grow quality, local food. But we believe a business can't truly be sustainable unless it sustains the people who make it possible. Thanks to everyone who buys local and supports our mission! #localfood #mushroomfarm# #asheville #livingwage
